claims.statement: SilverSea is a pnpm monorepo: Express+TS backend on port 3001, React 19+Vite frontend on strictPort 7174, shared @tingting/shared package; the layered backend service modules live in backend/src/services on Drizzle/Postgres with JWT+Casbin RBAC.
Financial precision is centralized in shared/src/calculations (round2dp, computeTripTotals); VND amounts carry no decimals and both apps share these functions.

The frontend FROZEN_MAX_LOC ratchet only shrinks; growing or adding an entry requires a justified change reviewed as a contract change. When two branches independently grow the same file, the ceiling is bumped to the actual merged line count with either a per-line comment naming both feature sets or, for bulk post-merge sweeps, a single global contract-change rationale in the file header. The 2026-09-09 origin/prod → main merge swept 48 entries by +1..+8 lines and is recorded as one such contract change in `structure.guard.test.ts`.
After editing shared/src, compiled shared/dist must be rebuilt (pnpm --dir shared build) or backend imports fail at runtime.
Report-cache invalidators exist in 3 copies; a new ledger-report pattern must be wired into all of them.

The atomic detailed-plan save persists carrier, vehicle, estimates, classification, and the optional driver note in one transaction guarded by both row versions, persists the dispatcher-owned classification, and strips the CUS-owned lot-level combined flag at the route.

The dispatch note composer drives a global tag pool with NFC-normalized duplicate detection, length and separator validation, and soft-delete that re-activates the same row on re-create, keeping historical notes readable.

The pre-commit hook typechecks any project with staged sources, runs the frontend structure guard, and refuses the commit on failure; escape hatch is git commit --no-verify with a stated reason in the commit body.

Shared schema changes require rebuilding @tingting/shared before backend tests that import its compiled package; the CUS workspace read model, the dispatch filter contract, and the debit-edit delta contract all live in @tingting/shared and are imported by backend services and frontend hooks.

The shared computeFuelSurcharge returns 0 when the base price is unset, when the share percent is non-positive, when quota liters are non-positive, or when the current price does not exceed the base; otherwise the surcharge is roundInt(round2dp(delta × quotaLiters × sharePct/100)); the pricing service persists the resolved inputs (customerSharePct, base price, quota liters) with each trip so future price changes do not retroactively rewrite cước đã phát hành.

The CUS dispatch-status chip vocabulary is now a five-state taxonomy (AWAITING_VEHICLE, PLANNED, CREATED, IN_TRANSIT, COMPLETED); the legacy coarse ASSIGNED/UNASSIGNED aliases remain accepted by the container endpoint so older links keep filtering.

The detail-plan row carries a taskStatus of 'READY' | 'DISPATCHED' | 'COMPLETED' and external-carrier staff close lets dispatch or CUS confirm completion when the external driver does not run the driver app; the same transitionTripStatus machinery used by the driver close fires so revenue/AP/AR post and ledger snapshots stay consistent.

The master-plan carrier-allocation editor splits demand by packing/return day via `DispatchAllocationDaySection` + `allocationDayHelpers`, validates against the per-day demand, and saves through a partial-save endpoint that echoes the persisted row back to the grid.

A CUS ledger container row stays at `PENDING_DATE` until every container in the FCL lot has its own `customerAppointmentAt`; clearing the last appointment of a lot that already moved to `READY_FOR_DISPATCH` is rejected with 409 so the workboard's "Chưa chốt ngày" warning can never silently clear.

The font-family contract bans font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and the JetBrains Mono fallback app-wide: Be Vietnam Pro uses proportional figures, so right-aligned numerics rely on text-align: right. Documented exception (2026-09-20): the debit settlement money tables ship tabular-nums (QA-passed on worked-number alignment) and are exempt from the no-tabular-nums scan; the allocation summary, schedule editor, and ledger rows honor the ban.

The CUS settlement surface reads consolidated lot money rollups from shipment-debit-summary.service (customer filter required, delivery-date range, lock status) and edits container-keyed freight/chi-hộ tables through shipment-debit-detail.service; the CUS may edit Phát sinh (PS thực tế) and ad-hoc no-invoice fees, while invoice-numbered chi hộ fees stay read-only. The L1 auto-freight rollup reads per-anchor supersede semantics: freight snapshots are INSERT-only, per-trip freezes are additive legs (latest row per (shipment, trip)), an active trip freeze supersedes the trip-NULL intake freeze, an intake-only lot counts once, and superseded freezes count in NO total — L1 equals Bảng 2.1 / debit_note_overrides.final_debit_freight.

Lock, freight-adjustment, and debit-note writes are registered in the material-write registry, and the registry grew with the 2026-09-20 customers overhaul: customers.bulk-notify and customers.bulk-status (lock/unlock) are registered endpoints requiring Idempotency-Key with in-transaction audit, and the exhaustive test suite asserts no out-of-registry writes slip in.

POST /shipments/debit-notes issues one consolidated debit note per customer per period: billing_documents rows typed DEBIT_NOTE are constrained by the partial unique index billing_documents_active_period_unique (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND type='DEBIT_NOTE'), so a duplicate customer+period issuance returns 409; XLSX export streams via billing-export-debit-note-xlsx.service.ts.

Shipment money states are intentionally separate: phải thu (receivable) ≠ đã thu (collected) ≠ đã khóa (locked) ≠ chưa xác định (unsettled — null renders 'Chưa xác định', never 0), the invariant maintained by the settlement surfaces per docs/prd/QuyTrinhO2C.md §7.

useBuildFreshness polls /api/health buildHash every 60 seconds against the value fetched at boot; polling pauses on hidden tabs and re-checks immediately on regain; polling stops permanently once a mismatch is flagged; a failed poll keeps the last-known state and never fabricates a mismatch.

StaleBuildBanner renders a faint fixed bottom-left role=status prompt that reloads only on click — an in-progress form is never auto-reloaded — and it mounts once in App() above the route tree, covering both the login screen and the authenticated shell.

The stale-build banner is the proactive complement of the reactive chunk-error handler: the handler reloads only after a lazy chunk already failed, and only after verifying a newer entry asset is reachable via an app-version-check fetch of the current origin.

Every confirm and modal surface carries role=dialog + aria-modal=true + an accessible name, and ConfirmDialog deliberately declares role=dialog rather than alertdialog because role-based lookups match exactly — neither CSS [role=dialog] nor testing-library getByRole('dialog') resolves alertdialog — which had made role-based a11y probes blind to every confirm modal; the attribute contract is pinned in UI.overlay.test.tsx and confirm-dialog.test.tsx.

Segmented datetime fields render one continuous frame — the group carries the control chrome at the shared 36px geometry, segments are borderless centered digit boxes, there is NO trailing trigger (the owner removed the calendar icon, card _25: the whole group click-opens the picker, per-segment svgs stay display:none), and min-width:max-content makes the group uncrampable by chained min-width:0 wrappers.

Filter and input wrappers run width:100% with min-width:0 so date fields size from content instead of forcing a horizontal scroll at laptop widths; the old pack-left footer contract was superseded by the two-row grid.

Fuel-price period config surfaces label the value "Giá dầu (đ/lít)" / "Giá dầu theo kỳ" without the DO unit suffix (2026-09-20 rename); the fuel type is implied by the config context. The table records creator attribution — a Người nhập column renders createdByName or 'Không xác định' for legacy rows (created_by populated on new periods since 2026-09-21).

Debit-note issuance is gated server-side on every §7.2 readiness condition — presentation lines exist, every line carries a non-zero grossAmount, and each source trip has pod_recovered_at/by (the POD-mộc-đỏ original-document recovery, not the ops paper-order handoff) — collected into one 409 whose details[] names each missing reason without masking, while eligible documents keep the prior validation path unchanged.

A fuel-price change exactly equal to the ngưỡng threshold counts as đạt ngưỡng and opens a new price period: the engine keeps the prior price only when the change is strictly below threshold, and the PRD docs were amended on 2026-09-20 to state this rule, matching running code.

When a fuel term is missing (UNSET threshold or unconfirmed lag) the freight preview renders the engine's MANUAL formula reason verbatim — naming lag, threshold, or missing base price — instead of a hardcoded 'Thiếu giá gốc' string, so users see what is actually missing and never a fabricated amount.

The dev/staging seed creates no invented 15T contract prices, so all environments match production: a 15T vehicle without customer prices resolves to MANUAL with reason 'Thiếu giá gốc cho 15T' rather than an automatic price.

The shipments-detail filter bar is a fixed two-row 12-column grid per the owner's 2026-09-20 spec (superseding the earlier one-row ruling): row 1 spans search 4 / from 2 / to 2 / customer 4; row 2 spans direction 3 / dispatch 3 / info 2 / connected date-preset segmented group 2 / ghost reset 2 right-aligned; all controls share a 36px geometry scoped to the bar; labelless rail slots stay bottom-flush via align-items:end; display:contents groups mean adding a filter never needs a track edit.

The finance P&L derive layer enforces the zero-vs-missing boundary: report-backed cells propagate null (rendered '—' by formatters) while ?? 0 appears only inside sums over defined arrays (arithmetic zero), and marginPct/yoyPct return '—' for null inputs.

Trips-list rows with truck vehicleClass '15T' and missing revenue render '—' plus a right-aligned in-cell chip 'Thiếu giá 15T' whose tooltip states the base price is missing and never displayed as zero; the predicate reads vehicleClass added to the trips-list payload.

The create-page goods table has no in-cell add buttons: route, port, and container-type creation happens by typing in the cell combobox, which offers a create option opening the prefilled create dialog (initialName/initialCode), with ShipmentCreateWorkspace ratcheted to 1130 lines for the listbox wiring.

The app has exactly one empty-state primitive — the design-system EmptyState with compact cards/rows/list preview variants; the parallel .empty-state chrome and the dead shared component were consolidated away, and the float animation carries a prefers-reduced-motion guard.

The fleet driver catalog renders license expiry through a pure state function: overdue rows get an oxblood icon+label ('Quá hạn N ngày'), rows within 30 days get bronze ('Còn N ngày'), long-dated/missing rows stay bare — a compliance-risk field never renders as plain data.

Workboard quick-edit of the schedule and notes cell groups is gated to CUS, ADMIN, and DISPATCHER: transportDateEditable is the (CUS|ADMIN|DISPATCHER) && !locked clause in the CUS workspace builders, and shipmentFieldAccess grants those three roles DIRECT access on the four schedule/notes keys (closingAt, plannedReturnAt, customerNotes, operationalNotes) before any lock check; other cell groups and other roles (e.g. MANAGER) are untouched.

Both note fields (customerNotes, operationalNotes) are decoupled from the shipment accounting lock ONLY: the FE notes trigger disables only when both fields are READ_ONLY (fieldAccess-driven); fieldAccess returns DIRECT for the two note fields for CUS/ADMIN/DISPATCHER even under hasActiveLock; and a notes-only update — a payload carrying nothing beyond the two note fields plus bookkeeping keys (expectedVersion/version/updatedBy) — skips assertShipmentAccountingUnlocked while any mixed update still 409s under lock. The dispatcher stage gate is role-scope, not payload-scope: assertDispatcherCanMutateShipmentIntake runs for DISPATCHER on EVERY update including notes-only (fixed 2026-09-21 after the exception briefly bypassed it), so a dispatcher cannot mutate a post-intake lot through the notes path; CUS/ADMIN are untouched by that gate.

OPS expense rights derive at save-time from live tables with no link-row syncing: the write is granted when the ops user holds a manual user↔shipment link (admin user form) OR an active truck_ops_assignments row whose truck hauls the lot on any non-canceled trip (auto-link via trucks, owner ruling 2026-09-20). Unassigning the truck removes the right on lots with no saved expenses yet.

The ops settlement sheet enforces display-key hygiene and export-format honesty: the settlement panel renders the business key (Số Bill/Booking) or '—' and never an internal lot id, and the export endpoint returns 400 with a clear message for unsupported formats instead of silently serving xlsx (xlsx remains the supported format; A4 print is the PRD's paper path).

FCL freight freezes anchor on the dispatching fulfillment's own container (type + appointment at dispatch, superseding the shipment's first-container heuristic), so FCL lots freeze freight even when shipments.route_id is null; ad-hoc (Lệnh chạy ngoài) lots are exempt and routeless derivations stay silent — no invented rates.
